First public release of TierwiseAgents: a Claude Code plugin that routes each piece of development work to the cheapest model tier that can do it well, and gates every push with tests and review.

## Install

```
/plugin marketplace add prayag17/TierwiseAgents
/plugin install tierwise-agents@prayag17
/tierwise-agents:orchestrate <your task>
```

## What is in it

- **Seven roles on three tiers.** `tw-architect` plans on the top tier; `tw-tester`, `tw-builder`, `tw-debugger` and `tw-reviewer` work on the mid tier; `tw-scout` and `tw-runner` handle reading and chores on the small tier.
- **A cycle sized to the task.** Small edits are done inline, renames go straight to the small model, and only real design work gets the full scout, plan, tests-first, build, gates and review cycle.
- **Plan files as the handoff.** The architect writes a self-contained plan with decisions, a risk level, gates and tasks, and you approve it before anything is built.
- **Quality gates run by a script.** `gate.py` runs lint, typecheck, tests, build and a smoke check and records exactly which code passed.
- **Push guard.** A hook blocks `git push` from Claude unless `HEAD` is the code that passed the gates.
- **Any model.** Defaults are `opus` / `sonnet` / `haiku`, with Fable for planning as an opt-in. Tiers and single roles can be set to any Claude model ID, or to a non-Claude model through an external coding CLI such as Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, opencode or aider.
- **Two ways to install.** As a plugin, or as a standalone skill copied from `skills/orchestrate/`.

## Known limits

- The command shapes documented for external CLIs are examples; confirm the flags with each tool's `--help`.
- The push guard covers pushes made by Claude inside Claude Code only. Keep branch protection on your Git host.
- No measured cost-saving figures yet. Reports from real projects are welcome.
